purpose: Test whether excluding the reported fixed point from outer warning region changes Avoid status while stationary; then restore original group configuration.

known_write_interface.payload_contract: complete AgvType object, id 1; not Agv id 424

preconditions: Explicit user confirmation for this temporary static parameter test; on-site supervision and no motion dispatch from any tool or UI.
Fresh automatic/stationary/no-active-task feedback and unchanged baseline/group membership.
validation_and_restore_plan: Submit only the two-coordinate change via verified group update interface.
Read group and effective robot parameters back; an accepted API response alone does not prove effect.
Observe fresh state without sending navigation or velocity requests.
Restore original two coordinates and verify both group and effective robot parameters.
Do not restart services, reset, relocalize, or bypass Idle checks. If immediate application or restoration cannot be verified, report failure and keep navigation withheld.
unknowns: UpdateParam immediate application/reload semantics have not been proven on this test.
No stopping-distance, full sensor-coverage, or full arm-sweep validation.
note: old_candidate.json/new_candidate.json are robot-parameter geometry comparison inputs only; they are NOT the AgvType update payload.
user_confirmation: 执行静态对照，结束恢复原值
